observations.why: The 'we' enacts communal-sharing — the team as an undifferentiated body that ships together, not an individual reporting personal accomplishment.
Quantifying output in points frames work in proportionality terms — cost/benefit accounting of delivered value, the market-pricing relational model.
Naming an integration as 'the key unlock' frames a shared enabler of collective progress — communal-sharing's logic of what unlocked the team's shared capacity.
